hypotheses.pgvector_hnsw: Lower p95 dense retrieval latency without unacceptable candidate recall or judged relevance loss.
hypotheses.distributed_runtime: Improve deployment reproducibility and failure diagnosis without weakening private-scope or snapshot guarantees.

conditional_decisions.kafka: Deferred until a reproducible PostgreSQL queue bottleneck is demonstrated; any adoption requires transactional outbox and idempotent replay.
conditional_decisions.redis: Deferred until measured repeat-query or admission pressure justifies another service; sessions remain in PostgreSQL.
conditional_decisions.streaming_retrieval: Retain bounded unary RPC until measured streaming benefits justify its cancellation and ordering complexity.
conditional_decisions.streaming_generation: Retain progress events and validated final answers; do not publish unvalidated generated claims.
conditional_decisions.autoscaling: Disabled while singleton worker locks and local storage constrain the workspace deployment.
conditional_decisions.askutd: Blocked on the real API, identity mapping, data permissions and retention contract.

release_gates: Live Kubernetes server-side dry-run and deployment
Real HTTPS OIDC callback, cookies, CSRF, upload and source-access flow
Cross-service collector trace including durable worker continuation
Representative frozen workload baseline and experiment reports
Backup/restore, pod interruption, database outage and rollback rehearsal
Owner review of quality, latency, memory and operational tradeoffs
